checkpoints.description: [1/2] Include Allow: POST, DELETE in the clear-endpoint 405 response

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed GET /__clear returns 405 without the Allow header required for that status.
impact_assessment.benefits: Clients can discover the supported clear methods from the response itself.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: an extra response header only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add optional headers to _send_json, send Allow on the clear 405, and add a raw-socket failing-first test.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Dedupe ids within a snapshot and reject duplicate Content-Length headers

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a snapshot with the same id twice imports both and makes the records unusable, and two conflicting Content-Length values are accepted with a truncated body.
impact_assessment.benefits: Imports cannot create ambiguous ids, and smuggling-shaped requests are refused.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: malformed HTTP gets 400 instead of 200, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: duplicate ids are skipped before any store write.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Track seen ids during import, use headers.get_all to detect multiple lengths before reading a body, and add failing-first tests for both.

checkpoints.description: [1/5] Validate port, preserve duplicate replay headers, support IPv6 loopback

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed an out-of-range port crashes with OverflowError, replay collapses duplicate headers, and ::1 is accepted as loopback but cannot bind.
impact_assessment.benefits: Friendly CLI errors, faithful replay of repeated headers, and working IPv6 loopback.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: invalid ports and ::1 now work as documented, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: none.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Add argparse port validation, ordered header pairs in replay, AF_INET6 selection with bracketed URL, and failing-first tests for each.

checkpoints.description: [1/4] Validate inbox before every append and keep Content-Length 0 on bodyless replay

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed a capture into a corrupt or unsupported-version inbox is acknowledged with 200 but never readable, and bodyless replay fails against strict targets.
impact_assessment.benefits: No acknowledged-but-lost captures, and faithful replay of bodyless webhooks.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: corrupt inboxes now fail captures with 500, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: decode stays under the store lock; state: no write occurs on validation failure.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Decode existing records before any write, always send Content-Length in replay, and add failing-first tests for both.

checkpoints.description: [1/3] Reject non-finite replay timeouts and validate clear request framing

impact_assessment.why: A probe showed --timeout inf crashes with OverflowError, and malformed Content-Length on POST /__clear silently wipes the inbox.
impact_assessment.benefits: Friendly CLI errors for bad timeouts and no destructive clear from malformed HTTP framing.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: malformed clear requests now get 400, so README and ADR must follow; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: a rejected clear leaves the inbox untouched.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use math.isfinite plus an upper bound in argparse, catch OverflowError as a backstop, share the Content-Length validation, and add failing-first tests.
